basic_info.description: This beautifully re-imagined Victorian seamlessly combines timeless architectural charm with modern design. Thoughtfully renovated, the 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features soaring ceilings, high end finishes , and a perfect floor plan for today's living. The main level flows effortlessly from the elegant living room into the dining area with a wood-burning fireplace, and into a stunning open-concept chef's kitchen. Outfitted with top-tier appliances including Wolf and Miele, the kitchen also features a cozy breakfast nookperfect for casual mornings. A walkout deck is contiguous to the kitchen and leads to a wonderful indoor/outdoor balance.  A powder room completes this level. A grand staircase leads to the upper level, where the primary suite features generous closet space and a beautifully finished en-suite bath with marble surfaces. Two additional sunlit bedrooms share a large marble bathroom. The lower level features a versatile en suite bonus roomideal for a media room, home office, guest room, gym, or au pair suitealong with a dedicated laundry area, exercise room, ample storage, and a 1-car garage. Ideally located just moments from Alta Plaza Park and a short stroll to the vibrant shops and restaurants along Sacramento, Fillmore and Divisadero Streets.
